question: Should this PR wait for affected-host packaged-app Auto and manual Refresh proof, or is the direct coordinator/auth-probe live output sufficient to accept the compatibility change?
rationale: The patch and focused tests look correct, but only a maintainer can accept the remaining real-environment uncertainty around the original macOS prompt symptom and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Require end-to-end affected-host proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted recording, logs, or terminal transcript showing a packaged background Auto refresh produces no Keychain prompt and clicking Refresh successfully retries Claude usage.

options.title: Accept the direct live proof
options.body: Merge based on the demonstrated coordinator skip and real user-initiated Claude auth probe, explicitly accepting that the complete app workflow was not observed.

recommendation.title: Require end-to-end affected-host proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted recording, logs, or terminal transcript showing a packaged background Auto refresh produces no Keychain prompt and clicking Refresh successfully retries Claude usage.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the final policy correction and has merger history for both the affected auth preflight and adjacent Keychain guard.
